video_title: Spurs Streak ENDS! Are the Non-Wemby Minutes a PROBLEM?!

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs struggle significantly when Victor Wembanyama is off the floor
quotes.excerpt: a minus 95 with Wemby off the floor

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: The non-Wemby minutes, we are going to do that. And look, Spurs fans are very loud about it as well. They are pretty glaring, a minus 95 with Wemby off the floor.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: I would say yes. I think that is something you have to figure out, especially when it comes to the regular season and keeping him healthy for the majority of that.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs need better defensive personnel for when Victor Wembanyama rests
quotes.excerpt: you can't really replace what Victor Wembanyama does, especially on the defensive end
quotes.quote: You can just see it when you watch the Spurs play, the minute he goes out of the game, that almost just triggers the offense to get downhill, attack the paint. I think they will have a little bit more flexibility when Tobias comes back, they will have a better of a small ball lineup, but you can't really replace what Victor Wembanyama does, especially on the defensive end. They are going to have to find ways, whether that is changing up their defenses, different coverages, that is up to Miss Johnson to kind of find the right personnel for those coverages, but that is a drastic drop off and something has to give because they are not very good without him on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's presence is a crutch for the Spurs' defense
quotes.excerpt: naturally, he's going to be a crutch to a lot of guys
quotes.quote: Every time Wemby went off the floor, OKC would go on runs. It was like they waited for him to go on runs and Miss Johnson, the way that he combated that was, he just played Wemby more minutes and you have to keep him on the court. But somebody that can impact the game on the offensive and defensive end like Wemby, I think naturally, he's going to be a crutch to a lot of guys. Especially when he is on the floor, everybody can take a deep breath and say, if I get beat, I know I have somebody behind me that can go and get that.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's hip injury is a major concern for the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: this is going to be a major blow for them if this is not a short-term injury

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: Dylan Harper left this one in the fourth. He had like one of those awkward slips that looks like a groin situation. If this is anything but a short-term injury, how devastating is it for the team?

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: This is going to be a major blow for them if this is not a short-term injury for the San Antonio Spurs. Out of all the guard play, Dylan Harper, he's been the most consistent.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox needs to step up as a consistent superstar guard
quotes.excerpt: it's more of a time where he has to step up and become a more consistent player
quotes.quote: As far as going into the depth, we keep forgetting about the guy that is making 40, 50, 60 million a year in De'Aaron Fox. I think it's more of a time where he has to step up and become a more consistent player and actually meet that role of being that superstar guard based off the numbers. So yeah, it is definitely a big hit to the Spurs to lose a guy like Dylan Harper in the lineup, but this is an opportunity for De'Aaron Fox to show the superstar that he is.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs' young roster is not a concern despite schedule strength
quotes.excerpt: I like the fact that they're such a young team and they handle business
quotes.quote: This would worry me with another team, a lesser team that is newly put together or younger or not as talented that then just go to the finals. This, obviously, they didn't make the schedule, you want to see them competing against the best, which we will see that eventually, but this is not a concern for me at all. I like the fact that they're such a young team and they handle business no matter who they play. It doesn't change what they do.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Western Conference parity makes every game critical for playoff positioning
quotes.excerpt: this is a larger issue for the for everybody that wants to win a championship
quotes.quote: I'm not concerned with the Spurs. You look around the league, man, there's five teams in the Western Conference that has almost identical records at this point. It's five teams in the Eastern Conference that have identical records at this point. This is a larger issue for the for everybody that wants to win a championship, not just the Spurs. There's a lot of competition out there, there's a lot of talent out there. At some point, somebody is going to create a little separation from the pack.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Danis Jenkins is emerging as a reliable second option for Detroit
quotes.excerpt: I think they might have it with Danis Jenkins
quotes.quote: I think the big concern, especially for our panel, was the where they didn't go and get that number two option, right? I think I think they might have it with Danis Jenkins. The way he has been balling, the way he is going, picking up 94 feet, but also initiating the offense, big guard. Listen, is he going to be a consistent number two all-star type player? I guess we don't know yet, but the way he has been producing, the way he does on both sides of the floor, he is starting to be more consistent of that guy. And with Jalen Duren out, and with the makeup of this team, he is the secondary ball handler. Obviously, they have shooting with Kevin Huerter and Duncan Robinson, they are going to make shots, but when Cade isn't great, my only concern is where does that come from? And man, it's been coming from Jenkins.
